scope: Independent read-only preimplementation design review; no production code or worktree writes

design.latestClarification: Root message adds literal strings and literal object keys; dictionary only profitable repeated strings/keys, deterministic first-appearance pruning; included in this review.

representationDecision.assessment: Generic typed tokens with one shared strings/keys dictionary are unambiguous and sufficiently narrow. Literal fallback is a reasonable smaller refinement; no need for semantic field elision, content schema change, runtime compression dependency or new routing capability.

requirements.rule: Validate and charge the whole encoded pack in a non-materializing first pass, then materialize only the selected record or validated complete pack. No decoded object/array tree, spread, flatMap or expanded JSON.stringify before the shared restored-byte guard passes.
requirements.evidence: record-data.ts public decode currently selects after validating every v1 entry; retain full-pack rejection semantics for v2.

requirements.rule: Restored size means exact UTF8 JSON serialization of the canonical v1 envelope (including all rows, record keys, brackets, commas, object key quotes/escapes, colons and wrapper fields). Dictionary costs cache UTF8(JSON.stringify(string)); charge each occurrence, not each unique string. Null/booleans/finite numbers use their exact JSON rendering; reject as soon as charged bytes >=25000000. Use safe, saturating arithmetic.

counterexample.note: Constructive design illustration only, not PCR or plant data; physical fits ordinary1MB target while restoredpack exceeds25MB.

requirements.rule: Writer must measure candidate restored bytes before calling a strict encoder that can throw for expansion. If pending exists and candidate physical>1000000 OR restored>=25000000 OR count>32, flush pending then recompute the singleton. Do not swallow malformed-input failures as capacity splits. Never emit a selected encoding that its public decoder rejects; one oversized physical record retains existing <25MB physical requirement and stays whole.

Grammar: null/boolean/literal-string pass as values; bare numbers are only safe integer refs0<=id<dictionary.length; actual number token is exactly[0,finite-number]; array is[1,...encoded-values]; object is[2,(literal-string|reference),encoded-value,...] with odd length. Reject unknown tags, wrong arity, raw objects, undefined, NaN/Infinity, float/negative/out-of-range refs, missing values, mixed token kinds and unsupported versions. Decoded manifest/structured roots must be objects, not arrays/scalars.

Dictionary strings and record keys are distinct; record keys nonempty, max32. Object keys are decoded then checked by Set<string>, covering mixed literal/ref collisions. Materialize with Object.fromEntries or Object.defineProperty own enumerable data properties, never target[key]=value on ordinary {} for __proto__. Test __proto__,constructor,prototype,toString,empty keys,numeric-like keys,Unicode and nested objects; preserve native Object.entries/JSON.stringify ordering.

Set an explicit shared nesting bound and check it before recursive descent in encoder/preflight/materializer. Confirm every actual current/history record is below it, and test exactly-at/one-past with controlled errors instead of RangeError. Iterative preflight is also acceptable. Physical JSON parsing already occurs before decode; this guard limits decoded expansion, not all response.json memory.

Frequency/first-appearance/ID pruning must be deterministic. Count both key and value occurrences, including literal-escaping UTF8 bytes and decimal reference widths/dictionary framing. Two rounds may be a conservative heuristic, not a global optimality claim. Final v1/v2 selection compares complete actual UTF8 serialized bytes, with v1 on ties. Validate v1 first and preserve its bytes for nonbeneficial cases.

Retain unkeyed and schema1 reads and exact missing-key/unknown-version/retry behavior. New artifacts ship their decoder. Old decoder accepting new schema2 is not promised; historical bytes/readers remain unchanged. Verify all1600 actual records through unchanged public decode entrypoint with exact serialized record identity, and run shipped-export comparison plus Root fresh full validation/docs build.

minimality: No smaller viable scheme has independent measured evidence here. A key-only dictionary or compressed JSON would need separate feasibility proof and can add ambiguity/runtime/browser complexity. The proposed literal branch removes avoidable dictionary overhead without changing semantic schema.
